_about: The learning log (src/core/learnlog.js; docs/DESIGN.md, 'Learning measurement'). kinds: the fields of each kind of event. The kind of a field: time (milliseconds since 1970), id (a short id from the data of the game: a skill, a task, a map, a variant), bool, count (a whole number, 0 or more), number, prob (0 to 1), numbers (a list of at most 50 numbers), or a list of the allowed words. A kind with ? can also be null. Every event has the fields type, t (the time), and variant. No name, no free text, no picture, and no device information. maxEvents: the most raw events of one day; mastered: the P(L) of mastery (as in learning.json); band: the target band of first-try success (rule 15). help: a move of the mentor of a task (src/core/mentor.js), with the outcome of the next commit; check: a check before a commit, and whether a change followed it (a self-correction); ask: a wave of the child, before or after a try, and the move that it got. summary: the fields that a shared summary may have, as paths with * for a key of a map. set: the end of a set of a practice (done, stay: the child played on, back). raid: the end of a raid, won or lost. quiz: a short question of the teacher (fact: the fact of the table, as 3x7; known: the fact is confident in the world). signals and activities: see their _about.

signals._about: The signals of the weekly note (#25; src/core/learnlog.js, weekRollups): fast, idle: a commit less than fast seconds (careless) or more than idle seconds (a long pause) after the commit before; gap: the most seconds between two commits that count as play; leave: a miss and then the end of the session or another activity within these seconds (the child left); missRun: misses in a row that make a run; hop: another activity within these seconds (hopping between stations); near: a miss off by at most this many groups is a near miss; recall: the bounds of the buckets of the seconds of a right commit of a fact of the table; few: less than this many commits or sessions is too few to tell.

activities._about: The activity of a task or a mentor key (src/core/learnlog.js, activityOf): the ids of the practice links (data/world/practice.json), the bridge, the small events, and the raids. A key that ends with - is the beginning of task ids. planting, ducks, traps, and drum are the activities of the memory of the facts (src/core/planting.js, from).
